name: @cne/brand
description: CNE Associates: brand marks, design tokens, fonts and asset templates.

scripts.build: pnpm build:tokens && pnpm build:assets && pnpm build:icons
scripts.typecheck: node --check tokens/build.mjs && node --check scripts/render.mjs && node --check scripts/icons.mjs && node --check scripts/board.mjs
scripts.explore:marks: node scripts/marks-explore.mjs && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --python scripts/render3d.py -- dist/explore 96 iris && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --python scripts/render3d.py -- dist/explore 96 focal
scripts.explore:monograms: node scripts/monograms.mjs && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --python scripts/render3d.py -- dist/explore 128 aperture-c && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --python scripts/render3d.py -- dist/explore 128 c-stack
